# Architecture Review Response

Use this skill when asked to review architecture artifacts, respond to architecture questions, or produce executive architecture review summaries.

## Procedure

1. Inventory reviewed artifacts and source versions.
2. Identify what was done well.
3. Identify issues, severity, locations, corrections, and residual risks.
4. Validate cross-document consistency.
5. Record finalized decisions and rationale.
6. Capture parked stories and future scope.
7. Provide a final recommendation only if blockers are resolved or accepted.

Use `templates/enterprise/executive-architecture-review.md` and `templates/enterprise/hld-review-response.md`.

**Why?** Review responses should be evidence-driven and decision-oriented.
